Our Work

Different products may serve different people. They begin with the same question.

Live

Hastareka

An AI-powered palm interpretation experience that brings traditional palmistry into a modern, interactive format. It explores patterns, symbolism, personality themes, and self-reflection through the human hand—our first exploration of how human interpretation can become an accessible digital experience.

hastareka.com 01
Built

MCQBrain

An AI-assisted medical learning tool designed for clinical students. MCQBrain helps learners practice, identify weak areas, and strengthen clinical reasoning through a more adaptive learning experience.

MCQBrain 02

Our Approach

Human problems are rarely limited to one field.

Medicine helps us understand the body. Communication helps us understand how people think, feel, connect, and make decisions. Technology helps us turn ideas into tools that can reach more people.

Sovereign Lab works at the connection between these areas. We explore human problems, connect different perspectives, bring people with different expertise together, and use technology to build practical solutions.

Our Foundations

Body

Medicine provides a foundation for understanding the human body, health, and the realities people experience.

Mind

Human behavior, communication, emotion, and decision-making help us look beyond information and understand the person behind it.

Connection

Communication creates understanding. It helps ideas move between people, fields, and communities—and turns individual knowledge into shared action.

Technology

Technology is our multiplier. It helps useful ideas become accessible tools, personalized experiences, and solutions that can reach beyond one person at a time.

The Idea Behind Our Work

What does this person need—and how can knowledge, communication, technology, and the right people come together to help?

We do not believe one person must know everything.

We believe meaningful progress happens when people from different fields understand one another, contribute their strengths, and build toward a shared human purpose.

Sovereign Lab grew from a personal journey through medicine, communication, human observation, and technology.

Studying medicine created a deeper interest in the human body and the problems people experience. Learning to communicate and speak created another perspective: how people think, feel, connect, make meaning, and respond to ideas. Technology opened a way to turn those interests into tools.

The goal is not to become an expert in every field. It is to understand people deeply enough to recognize meaningful problems, communicate ideas clearly, connect people with different expertise, and help turn possibilities into useful solutions.

I am grateful to every teacher, collaborator, community, tradition, and challenge that contributed to this journey. Sovereign Lab is an ongoing exploration—built with curiosity, guided by people, and strengthened through collaboration.

A small contribution to the human community.

Our Vision

To build human-centered solutions by connecting people, knowledge, communication, and technology.

We start with people. We connect possibilities. We build what helps.
